spans.s: Śineḥ pautra(ḥ), Śineḥ putra(ḥ) = Sātyaki, q.v.
Śineḥ suta(ḥ)^1 = Satyaka, q.v.--Do.^2 = Sātyaki, q.v.
Śiner naptṛ = Sātyaki, q.v.

Śini^1, father of Satyaka and grandfather of Sātyaki (Yuyudhāna). § 599e (Jayadrathavadhap.): Atri > Soma > Budha > Purūravas > Āyus > Nahusha > Yayāti > Yadu (by Devayānī) >…Devamīḍha > Śūra (equal to Kārtavīrya) > Vasudeva; in Śūra's race was born Ś. About this time the svayaṃvara of Devaka's daughter Devakī took place, whom Ś. took up in his chariot for the sake of Vasudeva. Somadatta attacked Ś., who threw him to the earth, seized him by the hair and struck him with his foot, and then let him off. Śiva granted Somadatta that he should have a son (i.e. Bhūriśravas) who should in like manner strike Ś.'s son (i.e. grandson = Sātyaki) with his foot: VII, 144, 6032, 6034, 6035, 6037, 6041 (ºeḥ sutaṃ, i.e. Sātyaki), 6043 (do.).
